routes.label_vi: Đặt keyframe cho thuộc tính
intent_aliases: thay đổi theo mốc thời gian
đổi vị trí theo các mốc thời gian
routes.summary: Insert a property value at a frame; keyframe_insert creates F-Curves and animation data when needed.
routes.choose_when: Represent a property changing at specified times.
do_not_assume: The valid, animatable data_path for the actual object is not yet known; read the property and probe before insertion.
Keyframes alone do not prove that motion or rendered images meet the request.

evidence.supports: Insert a property keyframe, creating F-Curves and animation data as needed; accept data_path and frame.

routes.label_vi: Điều khiển thuộc tính bằng driver
intent_aliases: thuộc tính phụ thuộc thuộc tính khác
routes.summary: A Driver controls a property; DriverVariable supplies inputs from RNA properties, transforms, distances between bones/objects or angles between bones.
routes.choose_when: Make a value depend on another input or expression instead of setting individual keyframes.
do_not_assume: The data_path, variable sources and expression execution in the current runtime are not yet verified.
Valid expression syntax does not prove the absence of dependency cycles.

evidence.supports: driver_add adds a driver to the property specified by path.
Driver variables use RNA properties, transforms, angular differences, distances or context properties.
expression stores a Scripted Expression.

routes.label_vi: Nội suy và đánh giá đường cong chuyển động
routes.summary: Keyframe.interpolation controls interpolation to the next keyframe; FCurve.evaluate returns the value at a frame.
routes.choose_when: Adjust transitions between keyframes or inspect numerical animation values at specific frames.
do_not_assume: Do not select interpolation enums from memory; read the linked enum list and verify the runtime.
An individual F-Curve value does not prove the final result after constraints, drivers or blending.

evidence.supports: Set the interpolation method for the F-Curve segment from this keyframe to the next.
evaluate(frame) returns the F-Curve value at the requested frame.

routes.label_vi: Tổ chức, phối hợp và lặp Action
routes.summary: An Action contains F-Curves; NlaStrip references an Action and controls repetition and blending with other strips.
routes.choose_when: Reuse, repeat or combine existing animation segments.
do_not_assume: The 5.2 source includes Action slots and layers; do not use a remembered older Action layout.
Compatibility of the Action slot with the target and the blending result remain unverified.

evidence.supports: An Action is a collection of animation F-Curves.
NlaStrip references an existing Action and has action_slot.
repeat sets the number of repetitions of the Action range.
REPLACE, COMBINE, ADD, SUBTRACT and MULTIPLY combine strip results.

routes.label_vi: Tạo hệ xương Armature
routes.summary: Armature contains a bone hierarchy, commonly used for character rigging; ArmatureEditBones.new creates an edit bone.
routes.choose_when: Create or edit a rig's bone structure.
do_not_assume: EditBone belongs to Edit Mode; verify mode/context before creating or editing.
A bone structure does not prove mesh deformation bindings or correct weights.

evidence.supports: An Armature data-block contains a bone hierarchy, commonly used for character rigging.
EditBone is a bone in an Armature data-block's Edit Mode.
new(name) adds a bone and returns EditBone.

routes.label_vi: Điều khiển tư thế bone
routes.summary: PoseBone holds bone pose data; matrix_basis accesses location, scale and rotation relative to the parent and the bone's rest state.
routes.choose_when: Set or animate pose data on an existing armature.
do_not_assume: Do not equate pose coordinates with world space or EditBone data; read each property's coordinate-space contract.
API documentation does not supply scene bone names or joint limits; inspect the actual scene.

evidence.supports: PoseBone is a channel defining bone pose data within a Pose.
matrix_basis accesses transforms relative to the parent and the bone's own rest state.

routes.label_vi: Ràng buộc sao chép transform
routes.summary: CopyTransformsConstraint copies a target's full transform and provides modes for combining it with the existing transform.
routes.choose_when: An object or bone needs the transform of a specified target.
do_not_assume: Do not select mix_mode, target space or owner space from memory; read this constraint's contract.
The documentation warns that some matrix combinations produce shear with rotation and non-uniform scale.

evidence.supports: Copy all transforms; describe mix_mode order and shear caveats.
ObjectConstraints.new adds a constraint by type.

routes.label_vi: Điều khiển chuỗi bone bằng IK
routes.summary: KinematicConstraint provides inverse kinematics; chain_count sets the affected bone count and iterations limits solver iterations.
routes.choose_when: Control an IK relationship within a bone chain.
do_not_assume: The API establishes IK parameters, not a complete rig for a particular character.
Read target, pole, chain and constraint spaces; solver convergence and the desired pose remain unproven.

evidence.supports: Describe inverse kinematics; chain_count=0 uses all bones and iterations limits solving.

routes.label_vi: Chuyển động theo đường Curve
routes.summary: FollowPathConstraint locks motion to a target Curve, with frame-relative offset or curve-length offset_factor and curve-following orientation.
routes.choose_when: Move an object or camera along a specified Curve.
do_not_assume: This route does not supply a Curve, keyframes or axis configuration; establish these from scene data and relevant sources.
The name Follow Path does not establish constant speed; measure positions by frame when required.

evidence.supports: Lock motion to a Curve target; offset_factor follows length and use_curve_follow follows curve heading/banking.

routes.label_vi: Tạo và điều khiển Shape Key
routes.summary: Object.shape_key_add creates a shape key, optionally from the current shape mix; ShapeKey.value gives its value at the current frame.
routes.choose_when: Create or animate shape keys for an identified object.
do_not_assume: Object support, compatible topology and the existence of the target shape are not yet established.
ShapeKey.points does not support legacy Curve shape keys; choose accessors for the actual data type.

evidence.supports: Add a shape key; from_mix creates the shape from the current mix.
value is the shape-key value at the current frame.
ShapeKey.points provides optimized access but excludes legacy Curve shape keys.

routes.label_vi: Bake chuyển động thành Action
routes.summary: nla.bake records selected objects' location/scale/rotation animation into an Action; visual_keying uses final transforms including constraints.
routes.choose_when: Record evaluated motion into an Action over a specified frame range.
do_not_assume: This bakes animation, not necessarily simulation caches.
clear_constraints, clear_parents and use_current_action modify existing data; use them only within the requested scope.
Check selection, mode, poll and the resulting Action after baking.

evidence.supports: Bake transform animation into an Action; visual_keying uses final transforms; document constraint/parent removal and writing to an existing Action.

routes.label_vi: Mô phỏng vật thể rắn
routes.summary: RigidBodyObject stores participant settings; RigidBodyWorld contains the simulation environment, participating collection, substeps and solver iterations.
routes.choose_when: Simulate objects with the Rigid Body system, collision settings and a shared environment.
do_not_assume: Creating settings does not mean simulation has run or caches have been baked.
Check the participating collection, collision shapes, frame range, runtime and evaluated results.

evidence.supports: Store rigid-body participant settings including collision shape and damping.
Define a self-contained environment; collection selects participants, while solver_iterations and substeps_per_frame trade accuracy for speed.
Add the active object as a Rigid Body.

routes.label_vi: Ràng buộc giữa vật thể rắn
routes.summary: RigidBodyConstraint affects objects in Rigid Body Simulation, with an impulse breaking threshold and angular limits.
routes.choose_when: Create physical constraints between rigid-body simulation participants.
do_not_assume: These are distinct from pose/object transform constraints.
The route name does not verify joint types, endpoints or a working simulation; read type and probe.

evidence.supports: Constrain rigid-body objects; breaking_threshold is the breaking impulse and angular limits are available.

routes.label_vi: Mô phỏng vải và va chạm vải
routes.summary: ClothSettings defines cloth simulation parameters including bending stiffness; ClothCollisionSettings manages self-collision and collisions with other objects.
routes.choose_when: Use Cloth simulation and adjust its collision response.
do_not_assume: A curtain keyword identifies a Cloth candidate; the source does not supply a curtain recipe or real-world material parameters.
Verify modifiers, geometry, caches and output frames; settings alone are not simulation proof.

evidence.supports: Define cloth bending models, stiffness and damping.
Configure self-collision and object collision; collision_quality trades time for quality.

routes.label_vi: Mô phỏng vật thể mềm
routes.summary: SoftBodySettings exposes soft-body simulation settings including bending stiffness, collision damping and aerodynamic interaction.
routes.choose_when: Simulate an object with the Soft Body system.
do_not_assume: The settings API does not provide suitable physical parameters for every material or topology.
Verify modifiers, colliders, frame evaluation and caches before claiming a working effect.

evidence.supports: Define object soft-body settings including bending stiffness, collision damping and aerodynamic interaction.

routes.label_vi: Mô phỏng chất lỏng
routes.summary: FluidDomainSettings provides a LIQUID domain; FluidFlowSettings provides LIQUID flow with inflow, outflow or geometry behavior.
routes.choose_when: Explore liquid simulation using a Fluid domain and flow.
do_not_assume: flow_source lists only NONE in this snapshot; do not invent additional enums from memory.
Domain/flow configuration does not create a simulation or baked water surface; inspect baking, caches and actual results.
A water keyword does not establish a need for simulation; compare supported geometry/material routes for still-image requirements.

evidence.supports: LIQUID creates a liquid domain; GAS creates a gas domain.
flow_type=LIQUID adds liquid; flow_behavior includes INFLOW, OUTFLOW and GEOMETRY; flow_source lists only NONE.
bake_all bakes the entire Fluid Simulation.

routes.label_vi: Mô phỏng khói và lửa
routes.summary: Fluid provides a GAS domain and SMOKE, FIRE or BOTH flow; domain parameters control density/heat buoyancy and combustion rate.
routes.choose_when: Simulate smoke or fire over time using Fluid.
do_not_assume: Simulation parameters alone do not establish shading or flame appearance.
Current build support, completed baking and valid caches are unverified; probe and inspect outputs.

evidence.supports: GAS creates a gas domain.
SMOKE adds smoke, FIRE adds fire and BOTH adds both.
alpha and beta control buoyancy from smoke density/heat; burning_rate controls combustion rate.

routes.label_vi: Trường lực, gió và nhiễu động
routes.summary: FieldSettings.type distinguishes WIND along local Z, TURBULENCE noise, VORTEX rotation and DRAG that reduces movement.
routes.choose_when: Select a candidate force for a compatible simulation system.
do_not_assume: Do not assume every object responds to FieldSettings; read the target simulation and effector weights.
WIND is described along local Z; inspect transforms and results instead of assuming a world axis.

evidence.supports: Describe WIND, TURBULENCE, VORTEX, DRAG and other force-field enum values.

routes.label_vi: Dynamic Paint với canvas và brush
routes.summary: DynamicPaintSurface is a canvas surface layer with a brush collection, influence and wet-paint color spreading speed.
routes.choose_when: Explore Dynamic Paint brush/canvas interaction.
do_not_assume: surface_type lists only PAINT in this snapshot; do not supply other modes from memory.
These parameters do not provide a complete paint-trail or baking recipe; read modifier/settings contracts and verify the runtime.

evidence.supports: A canvas surface selects brushes with brush_collection and controls wet-paint mixing with color_spread_speed.
The snapshot's surface_type enum contains only PAINT.

routes.label_vi: Thiết lập hệ hạt Particle
routes.summary: ParticleSettings can be shared across particle systems; the snapshot's type enum includes EMITTER and HAIR.
routes.choose_when: Control a Particle System identified in the supplied source or scene.
do_not_assume: Do not equate particle HAIR with all hair systems or Geometry Nodes; read the correct data type.
EMITTER/HAIR establish enum values, not motion, rendering or cache recipes for a particular effect.

evidence.supports: Settings can be reused by multiple particle systems.
type includes EMITTER and HAIR; the anchor does not explain their workflows.

routes.label_vi: Bake và kiểm tra cache vật lý
routes.summary: PointCache exposes physics cache paths, frame ranges and is_baked/is_baking; ptcache.bake is a physics baking operator.
routes.choose_when: Execute or verify caches for a simulation using PointCache.
do_not_assume: ptcache.bake is not universal; Fluid has separate baking operators.
Distinguish FINISHED, is_baked and actual cache/frame data; no single signal proves the complete result.

evidence.supports: PointCache is the active physics cache, with filepath, frame_start/end, is_baked/is_baking and skipped-frame status.
The operator is described as Bake physics.
Fluid has a separate operator for baking the entire simulation.

routes.label_vi: Mở và lưu dự án .blend
routes.summary: wm.open_mainfile opens a Blender file; wm.save_as_mainfile saves the current file to a specified location.
routes.choose_when: Load a .blend project or save a script's output as .blend.
do_not_assume: Opening a file replaces current data; identify the requested input and output files.
Do not enable use_scripts or overwrite unrelated files automatically; read load/save options and inspect the created file.

evidence.supports: Open a Blender file with load_ui and use_scripts options.
Save the current file with copy, compress and relative_remap options.

routes.label_vi: Link, append và ghi thư viện data-block
routes.summary: BlendDataLibraries.load exposes available data-block names and links/appends selected names when its context ends; write saves selected data-blocks and indirect references.
routes.choose_when: Reuse part of another .blend file or package data-blocks as a library.
do_not_assume: Treat context-manager input as read-only and place selected names in its output as documented.
Choose link/append and paths according to the request; loading a data-block does not prove collection membership.

evidence.supports: The context manager returns input/output; output names are linked or appended on exit and input is read-only.
Write data-blocks to a blend file, expanding indirectly referenced data-blocks.

routes.label_vi: Đánh dấu asset và gắn metadata
routes.summary: ID.asset_mark enables data-block reuse through the Asset Browser; AssetMetaData stores description, author, tags and a catalog identifier.
routes.choose_when: Mark a reusable data-block and prepare asset metadata.
do_not_assume: Marking an asset does not establish library configuration or publication.
catalog_id must meet the source's UUID requirement; a catalog name is not its ID.

evidence.supports: Enable reuse through the Asset Browser with previews, descriptions and tags.
Metadata includes author, description and catalog_id; catalog_id must be an RFC4122 UUID.

routes.label_vi: Nhập và xuất OBJ hoặc STL
routes.summary: wm.obj_import loads Wavefront OBJ scenes; wm operators import/export OBJ and STL with scale, axis and object-selection parameters.
routes.choose_when: Exchange files in OBJ or STL format.
do_not_assume: Successful STL export does not prove printability or watertightness.
Read scale, axes and modifier options and verify runtime operators; do not use remembered older operator names.

evidence.supports: Load a Wavefront OBJ scene with scale and forward/up axes.
OBJ export declares export_selected_objects, apply_modifiers, scale and axes.
Import STL as an object.
Save the scene as an STL file.

routes.label_vi: Nhập và xuất glTF 2.0
routes.summary: import_scene.gltf loads glTF 2.0; export_scene.gltf exports scenes with documented geometry, material, animation, skin and morph options.
routes.choose_when: Exchange glTF/GLB or inspect glTF 2.0 transfer options.
do_not_assume: Export options do not guarantee faithful transfer of every shader, constraint or animation.
Verify operator registration, read the actual export_format enum and validate the file in a suitable consumer.

evidence.supports: Import glTF 2.0 with glb/gltf filters.
Export a scene to glTF 2.0 with export_animations, export_skins and export_morph parameters.

routes.label_vi: Nhập và xuất FBX
routes.summary: import_scene.fbx loads FBX; export_scene.fbx writes FBX with object, axis, armature and animation-baking options.
routes.choose_when: Exchange files in FBX format.
do_not_assume: The documentation warns that some importers do not support scaled armatures; verify the target consumer.
Default bake/axis/bone options do not guarantee correctness; read parameters and validate by re-import or target consumer.

evidence.supports: Import FBX with animation and bone-orientation options.
Write FBX with bake_anim and armature options; global_scale warns about importer support for scaled armatures.

routes.label_vi: Nhập và xuất USD scene
routes.summary: wm.usd_import imports a USD stage into the scene; wm.usd_export writes a USD archive with geometry, light, camera, material, animation and unit options.
routes.choose_when: Exchange USD scenes or inspect source-documented USDZ export options.
do_not_assume: USDZ parameters do not establish compatibility with every target consumer; read the options and test.
Verify USD build support and exported/imported scene content, including units and material conversion.

evidence.supports: Import a USD stage with camera, light, geometry, skeleton and material options.
Export a USD archive; the signature includes export_animation, convert_scene_units and usdz_downscale_size.

routes.label_vi: Nhập và xuất Alembic archive
routes.summary: wm.alembic_import loads Alembic archives; wm.alembic_export writes scenes with frame ranges, transform/geometry samples and data options.
routes.choose_when: Exchange Alembic files or inspect frame-range scene export to this archive format.
do_not_assume: The API does not prove preservation of every Blender data type; verify the required fields.
as_background_job does not guarantee operation in every CLI context; probe operators/build and inspect output files.

evidence.supports: Load an Alembic archive with set_frame_range and as_background_job.
Export an Alembic archive with start/end, xsamples, gsamples and UV, normal, hair and particle options.

routes.label_vi: Đường dẫn và đóng gói tài nguyên ngoài
routes.summary: blend_paths lists external .blend references; abspath resolves // paths; pack_all/unpack_all pack or extract .blend resources.
routes.choose_when: Audit resource paths or move between packed and external resources.
do_not_assume: A path list does not prove file existence or content correctness; inspect required resources.
Unpack modes write external files; use only requested destinations and behavior.

evidence.supports: List external paths referenced by the loaded .blend.
Resolve // paths relative to the blend file or library.
Pack used external files into the .blend.
Unpack resources using the selected method.

routes.label_vi: Kiểm tra runtime, build và background context
routes.summary: bpy.app exposes version, background state and build options; context depends on the accessed area and operators need suitable context.
routes.choose_when: Inspect API, engine and operator availability in the running Blender before CLI implementation.
do_not_assume: Documented build_options describe the documentation build; inspect the actual runtime.
No exception does not establish success: operators can return CANCELLED without raising.

evidence.supports: version returns a major/minor/micro tuple.
background is True when started without a UI using -b.
The snapshot exposes build options including fluid, usd, alembic and cycles.
Wrong context may raise RuntimeError; poll helps check it and CANCELLED may not raise.
Available context members depend on the accessed area.

routes.label_vi: Callback theo sự kiện ứng dụng
routes.summary: bpy.app.handlers provides callback lists; persistent retains callbacks when another file is loaded.
routes.choose_when: Run logic on frame events or Blender load/render lifecycle events.
do_not_assume: Handlers are removed on file load by default; persistent is a separate choice.
The source warns that simultaneous handler data changes and render/viewport access can crash; read the warning and choose appropriate synchronization.

evidence.supports: Provide callback lists including frame_change_pre/load_post, with warnings about changing data during rendering.
A decorator retains callbacks across file loads.

routes.label_vi: Hẹn và lặp callback trong ứng dụng
routes.summary: bpy.app.timers.register calls a function after a delay; return a float to schedule the next call or None to unregister.
routes.choose_when: Schedule callbacks within a Blender process that remains running.
do_not_assume: Timers do not run after the CLI process exits and are not an external scheduler.
Do not substitute remembered Python threads that access Blender data; read the separate threading limitations.

evidence.supports: Register a no-argument function with first_interval in seconds; None unregisters and a float sets the next delay.
Python integration is not thread-safe; the source limits threading and discusses multiprocessing for Blender-independent code.

routes.label_vi: Nhận thông báo thay đổi RNA property
routes.summary: bpy.msgbus receives RNA property-change notifications; subscribe_rna registers callbacks for a property or struct/property pair.
routes.choose_when: Respond to property changes made through the Python data API or UI fields.
do_not_assume: Animation and object movement in the 3D Viewport do not trigger msgbus according to the source; select another route for those events.
Loading another blend clears subscriptions; msgbus PERSISTENT preserves ID remapping, not file-load subscriptions.

evidence.supports: Receive RNA/Python/UI field changes, excluding animation and viewport movement; callbacks are deferred until after operators.
Subscribe to notifications; file loads clear subscriptions and PERSISTENT preserves ID remapping.

routes.label_vi: Mở rộng operator, property và UI
routes.summary: bpy.utils.register_class registers Blender subclasses; bpy.props defines their properties; Panel contains UI elements.
routes.choose_when: Create reusable operators/properties or controls inside Blender.
do_not_assume: A Panel is UI; class creation does not establish display or interaction in background -b.
Assign bpy.props results to registered classes rather than using them directly; property callbacks may run in threaded contexts.

evidence.supports: Register supported subclasses including Operator, Panel, PropertyGroup and Node.
Define properties for registered classes; avoid direct use and observe callback threading warnings.
Panel contains UI elements; the snapshot leaves context/region/space combinations as a TODO under bl_context.

routes.label_vi: Vẽ GPU và buffer ngoài màn hình
routes.summary: gpu exposes GPU wrappers, geometry batches and GPUOffScreen; the 5.2 source includes gpu.init for background initialization.
routes.choose_when: Draw through the GPU API, process offscreen buffers or render a 3D View into a texture.
do_not_assume: GPU use is not necessarily UI-only: gpu.init documents background use but may raise SystemError.
GPUOffScreen.draw_view3d still requires SpaceView3D and Region; do not assume they exist in -b.
Initialize shader uniforms explicitly; freeing offscreen resources makes framebuffer, texture and render objects inaccessible.

evidence.supports: Expose GPU wrappers and geometry batches with vertex/index buffers.
Initialize the GPU for background use; failure raises SystemError.
Access offscreen buffers; draw_view3d needs a scene, view layer, SpaceView3D and Region.
Initialize shader uniforms to avoid retaining earlier values.
Freeing offscreen resources makes associated framebuffer, texture and render objects inaccessible.

routes.label_vi: Compute shader trên GPU
routes.summary: GPUShaderCreateInfo accepts GLSL compute source; create_from_info creates a shader; gpu.compute.dispatch runs workgroup dimensions and capabilities reports support.
routes.choose_when: Use compute shaders directly through Blender's GPU API.
do_not_assume: The name GPU does not establish compute availability; check compute_shader_support_get and initialize the runtime.
GLSL cross-compilation documentation is linked outside the corpus; do not fill that missing content from memory.
A dispatch API does not prove shader correctness, input/output data, synchronization or numerical results.

evidence.supports: Accept GLSL compute shader source; include examples and an external cross-compilation documentation link.
Create GPUShader from GPUShaderCreateInfo.
Dispatch compute work using a shader and x/y/z group counts.
Return whether compute shaders are supported.
